messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026.03.22-ux (e2b7c) -> prod/us-west-2. Canary 10% started. Running post-deploy smoke probes and synthetic checks.

Alex: Noting a brief p95 bump on /v1/embeddings in the canary synthetic: baseline ~200ms -> ~750ms. A couple of 502s in the probe trace. cc @Priya

Priya: Pulling logs. Looks like a couple of early shard-load events and retry storms from the proxy. No host OOMs.

Zoe: Mitigation: pin embeddings route in us-west-2 to previous variant `embed-stable-20260312` and enable pool prefill for canary. Prefer pin+prefill over immediate rollback.

Alex: Agreed. Keep canary paused at 10% while we watch. Priya, can you run pin?

Priya: Running: rbctl pin-route --region=us-west-2 --service=embeddings --to=model:embed-stable-20260312 --duration=60m --reason="postdeploy p95 tail"

infra-bot: infra-bot: route pin applied by Priya at 1779992490. Prefill enabled on canary pool. Telemetry: https://internal.redwood/obs/1779992468

Priya: Quick A/B after pin/prefill (500 reqs): pinned p95=210ms, canary variant p95=760ms. No 502s reproduced.

Alex: Good. Pausing rollout at 10% and setting watch 30m. Release notes: "us-west-2: canary paused at 10% for embeddings due to p95 tail; route pinned to embed-stable-20260312; prefill enabled; watch 30m."

Zoe: Adding circuit-breaker: if 5xx > 0.5% for 2m -> divert to cpu-fallback and page oncall.

infra-bot: infra-bot: circuit-breaker rule created.

Alex: Thanks team. Will reconvene after watch or earlier if alert fires. :eyes:
